testCase:
R-18: Compare available plans for the SkyAPI on fakeflightaware.com.
Goal: Compare available plans for the SkyAPI on fakeflightaware.com.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-18/
STEP 2: Hover over "Products"
STEP 3: Click "SkyAPI (query API)"
STEP 4: Click "Plans & pricing"
STEP 5: Click "Compare plans"
STEP 6: Verify "Showing: SkyAPI plan comparison" is visible

steps.note: Verify the requested comparison view is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that the SkyAPI product navigation leads to the plan comparison view. The plan follows the specified hover and clicks, then asserts the exact confirmation text is visible.
